name: doc-control
description: Deterministic control of Word documents: addresses, tracked-change edits, live control of the Word you have open.
long_description: doc-control edits .docx files on your machine through stable addresses and anchors, with tracked-change batches, a dry run before every write and a safety layer that refuses unsafe edits. With Microsoft Word open, it can also drive the document you are working on. Everything runs locally; doc-control sends nothing off the machine.
